These are marketing claims on the vendor's own site, not GST turnover, GeM/CPPP tender awards or audited contract records. No GST turnover band, no tender/contract document and no annual-report revenue split was found. Source counter: 1 company website read, 0 independent domestic supply records seen.
note: Identity mismatch to flag: the record's legal_claimed field says 'BAJAJ GENERAL INSURANCE LIMITED', which is an insurer and has nothing to do with this supplier. The operating entity behind rotexautomation.com self-identifies in its site footer as '© 2026 Rotex Automation Limited' — a solenoid valve / flow-control manufacturer in the instrumentation space, not an IT/electronics trader. The declared HS 848120 (valves for oleohydraulic or pneumatic transmissions) is in fact consistent with the product line (solenoid valves, actuators, positioners), so the industry_claimed label 'IT и электроника' is the wrong field, not the HS code. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN, revenue figure or export volume is public in anything I could read — all left null rather than estimated. Per Rule 5, the website's 'Countries Served Worldwide' counter and the customer testimonials are declared, not confirmed: no customs/B-L record with date, destination and HS code was obtained, and no GST turnover or public-procurement award was obtained. Verdict on evidence: следов поставок не найдено в доступных источниках — neither export nor domestic supply is documented by a verifiable record; export_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' only because the paid trade databases blocked access (403) and the free importkey view rendered no rows, so absence of records is not proven. Recommend re-running against a paid Volza/Eximpedia account before any decision; do not treat the site's counters as shipment evidence.
